mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheduled_job_execution (id, job_name, batch_key, status, attempts, processed_count, error_message, started_at, finished_at, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobName}, #{batchKey}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{processedCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{nextAttemptAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheduled_job_execution SET status = #{status}, attempts = #{attempts}, processed_count = #{processedCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_trend_snapshot (snapshot_at, post_id, rank_no, score, reason) SELECT #{snapshotAt}, ranked.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ranked.score DESC), ROUND(ranked.score, 6), '互动质量与时间衰减综合排序' FROM ( SELECT id, (like_count * 3 + comment_count * 4 + favorite_count * 5 + repost_count * 6 + LOG(1 + view_count)) / POW(GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, published_at, #{snapshotAt}) / 60.0, 0) + 2, 1.15) AS score FROM community_post WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND published_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) ranked

INSERT IGNORE INTO integration_event_manual_review (event_id, reason, status, created_at) SELECT id, CONCAT('Outbox 自动投递已达到 ', attempts, ' 次'), 'PENDING', #{now} FROM integration_outbox WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'PROCESSING') AND attempts >= 8
